title: Vincible Moon Datapack
description: Dependency for upcoming update 2.0 of The Vincible plugin, planned to be optional
body:
# Lunar Descent

A stylized moon dimension for Paper 1.21.1 servers. Fly high enough and leave the world behind.

---

## Traveling to the Moon

Reach **Y=500** in the overworld while flying and you'll breach the atmosphere. A brief blindness transition plays, then you're dropped onto the lunar surface. To return, do the same thing from the moon — fly to Y=500 and you'll re-enter the atmosphere and land back at the exact coordinates you left from.

---

## The Dimension

The moon uses the **End skybox** — pure black void with stars. No weather, no day cycle, fixed night, and low ambient lighting. The surface is made entirely from a handpicked palette of vanilla blocks:

- **Calcite** — primary surface, bright and sterile
- **Tuff** — scattered patches for variation
- **Smooth Basalt** — darker surface regions and deep bedrock layer
- **Basalt** — crater rims and maria patches
- **Dead Tube Coral Block** — dark spots across the surface
- **Cobbled Deepslate** — crater floors
- **Cyan Terracotta** — sub-surface layer
- **End Stone** — deep underground filler

---

## Terrain & Features

The terrain generates as gently rolling plains with no oceans or caves. On top of that, several features scatter across every chunk:

**Craters** — small (radius 2–5) and large (radius 6–12) impact craters with cobbled deepslate floors and basalt rims, generated fresh every chunk.

**Maria patches** — dark basalt and smooth basalt regions mimicking the moon's real dark seas.

**Dead coral spots** — small scattered dark patches across the surface.

---

## Ores

All ores spawn as their **deepslate variants** embedded in the sub-surface layers. Rarity and depth follow a realistic distribution:

| Ore | Depth | Rarity |
|-----|-------|--------|
| Coal | 20–55 | Common |
| Copper | 10–50 | Common |
| Iron | 5–50 | Common |
| Gold | 0–30 | Uncommon |
| Lapis | 0–35 | Uncommon |
| Redstone | 0–25 | Uncommon |
| Diamond | 0–15 | Rare |
| Emerald | 0–10 | Very rare |

---

## Lunar Pods

Scattered roughly every **1000 blocks** across the surface, lunar pods are small structures — a ring of smooth basalt and cobbled deepslate with a **barrel at the center**. Inside the barrel you'll find the **Viltrum Serum**, a one-of-a-kind item that permanently grants Viltrumite powers when consumed.

> Requires the [Vincible plugin](https://www.curseforge.com) to be installed for the serum effect to activate.

---

## Requirements

- Paper 1.21.1
- Java 21
- Vincible plugin (for the Viltrum Serum item effect)
